topics.title: Iman ke arkan
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Suno! Aaj hum 'Iman ke arkan' seekhenge — adab aur pyar ke sath.

## SAMJHAO
Grade 2 ke liye asaan baat: Iman ke arkan. Yeh Islam ki khoobsurat taleem hai. Key points: Allah, Malaika, Kutub, Rusul.

## MISAAL
Islamabad / ghar / school mein isay amal mein lao — jaise Allah aur Malaika.

## KARO
Aaj ek kaam: Allah par iman. Phir family ko batao ke aapne kya seekha.

## SAWAAL
1) Iman ke arkan ka matlab kya hai?
2) Aap ghar mein isay kaise amal karoge?
3) Ek misaal do.
